# mini_reg
- purpose: Semi-automatic registration assistance for company-owned mini apps
- version: 0.1.0
- platforms: wechat, douyin, qq, alipay
- app_kinds: mini_program, mini_game; explicit per task
- runtime: native Rust executable; existing dedicated enterprise Chrome required for browser commands
- dependencies: no Python, Node.js, Playwright, external database or daemon; OS standard libraries required
- storage: bundled SQLite; transactional imports; WAL; FULL synchronization; OS app-data directory or --db
- commands: init, import, list, next, show, open, fill, confirm, export, browser bind, browser tabs, selectors
- batch_resume: next --open; stable batch/task-ID order; confirmed tasks skipped; existing tab not reopened
- browser: native loopback HTTP/WebSocket CDP; gamesci-lite.com corporate metadata and process fingerprint required
- form: visible unique name/summary inputs; exact labels or persistent CSS selectors
- default_fill: dry run; --apply required for text writes
- manual: app kind selection, icons/documents, categories, identity, consent, payment, submission
- confirmation: human-reported AppID; platform_verified=false
- interrupted_write: needs_review committed before write; no final registration retries
- output: --json single stdout envelope; stderr logs; overwritten per-run .log sidecar
- export: task metadata only; excludes browser binding and login data
- validation_status: live platform forms not acceptance-tested
- build_release: dedicated Jenkins workers; existing r_lit R2/HFrog pipeline
- usage_example: mini_reg init batch.toml; mini_reg import batch.toml; mini_reg list --json
